sentence: In hospitality it moderates selectively, touching only the path from dynamic capabilities to value
passage: [Alam et al. (2025), p. 1] "This study explores the relationship between technology readiness, AI adoption, dynamic capabilities, sustainable competitive advantage, and technological turbulence, assessing their collective impact on value creation within the Malaysian hospitality industry." / "the moderating effects of technological turbulence were selective, significantly influencing only the relationship between dynamic capabilities and value creation."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states as a finding that in the hospitality industry, the moderating effect was selective and only influenced the relationship between dynamic capabilities and value creation.
